messages:
deploybot: Pipeline started for staging — tag v1.14.0-rc3 — commit abcdef12 — initiated by maria. Stages: build -> lint -> unit -> e2e. ETA ~12m.
maria (Eng/Release): kicking off rc3 for the feature-flag rollout. change window tonight 18:00-20:00 PT. will attach release notes after canary.
deploybot: build: SUCCESS (3m 22s). artifact: s3://redwood-ci/ci-artifacts/abcdef12.tar.gz
deploybot: lint: FAILED — 14 warnings, 3 errors. Failing rule: no-restricted-syntax (eslint v8.40). logs: https://ci.redwood.example/logs/2999001234/lint
kevin (Eng/Infra): seeing the same locally. errors originate from regenerated types in @renderer/ui@2.1.0 — looks like the lockfile auto-bumped it. suggestion: pin to 2.0.x on release branch.
oliver (QA): unit tests: 128/130 passed. two snapshot failures in layout snapshots. rerun?
qa-bot: @oliver triggered rerun-tests for commit abcdef12 — unit tests rerun: all passed. (flaky)
carla (PM): :thinking: decision point — do we hold rc3 or pin @renderer/ui to 2.0.x in the release branch? We have the change window.
maria (Eng/Release): recommend pinning the dependency in the release branch (quick lockfile revert) and re-run lint in CI. If lint still errors, fallback is to eslintignore third_party/ or relax the rule for generated files.
kevin (Eng/Infra): I'll push a lockfile revert to branch release/v1.14.0-lockfix now. That will trigger CI rerun. ETA ~8m.
deploybot: lint: RUNNING
deploybot: lint: SUCCESS — 0 errors, 9 warnings (3 auto-fixed). full logs: https://ci.redwood.example/logs/2999001234/lint/2
deploybot: unit: SUCCESS
deploybot: e2e: STARTING
deploybot: e2e: FAILED — timeout on /payment flow on chrome-110. error: webdriver timeout. logs: https://ci.redwood.example/logs/2999001234/e2e
oliver (QA): that /payment timeout is a known flaky on chrome-110 infra. QA-runner shows ~67% flake rate for that infra pool since last infra rollout. can we rerun e2e on a different pool or use canary?
kevin (Eng/Infra): we have canary pool staging-canary-02 running chrome-108. Recommend rerun e2e there. Also propose extending change window by 30m if we need to continue debugging.
maria (Eng/Release): lint is green and unit tests stable. let's rerun e2e on staging-canary-02. If e2e passes there we can do a 10% canary deploy. I'll note in release notes that the e2e inconsistency is infra-related and we're pinning the dependency.
deploybot: e2e (staging-canary-02): RUNNING
deploybot: e2e (staging-canary-02): SUCCESS — all checks passed. logs: https://ci.redwood.example/logs/2999001234/e2e/canary. Canary deploy scheduled: 10% at 2026-03-20T18:15:00-07:00.
maria (Eng/Release): :rocket: rolling canary. release notes draft: - pinned @renderer/ui to 2.0.x to avoid new lint failures; - fixed lint noise by auto-fix and ignore for generated files; - e2e canary passed on staging-canary-02.
carla (PM): good. I'll hold external release note until canary stabilizes for 30m and then send a short blurb. monitoring dashboard up.
deploybot: canary: IN_PROGRESS — 10% traffic. dashboard: https://metrics.redwood.example/canary/2999001234 — initial latency and error rate within SLO.
oliver (QA): monitoring: slight 0.2% uptick in p95 on embeddings route, looks like noise, no errors observed.
maria (Eng/Release): if canary holds for 30m, promote to full staging and schedule prod cutover sometime in the 18:00-20:00 PT window.
deploybot: release branch merged: release/v1.14.0-rc3 pinned and merged by maria. Final status: canary started. thread closed by maria via /release-notes
